name: Jet Amplifier - Re-ATK
RelatedDescription: This jetpack enables an ST to fly over short distances, quickly traversing obstacles to reach even the most inaccessible corners of the battlefield. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Re-ATK capability.

61210.name: Flying Device I · Re-ATK
61210.SpecificEffects:
ST Move Method changes to levitation, enabling ST to pass over low obstacles.
After triggering [Re-ATK], Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
